description: A floor-length russet wool Vlandian gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, naturally fitted opaque bodice and elbow sleeves. Narrow gold woven bands edge the neckline, waist, cuffs and front. A simple decorated belt with small round clasp and an ochre shoulder wrap resting along the arms add restrained trim. A modest below-knee walking opening reveals the underlayer and brown leather shoes.
